boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 80 fills the board with tall green and blue/cyan vertical columns separated by a center gap of red lock-and-key blocks. The columns cannot move until the lock sequence in the center is solved. Clear the lock-and-key blocks first to open the gap, then slide the tall green columns down through the bottom exits, followed by the blue/cyan columns.
landmarks: Block Out Level 80 fills the board with tall green and blue/cyan vertical columns separated by a center gap of red lock-and-key blocks.
The columns cannot move until the lock sequence in the center is solved.
Clear the lock-and-key blocks first to open the gap, then slide the tall green columns down through the bottom exits, followed by the blue/cyan columns.

quickTips: Focus entirely on the center lock-and-key gap first — no column moves until it opens.
Slide green columns down before blue/cyan — green is closer to the exits.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Match the key blocks with their corresponding lock blocks in the center gap.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the unlocked red blocks from the center to open the gap.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Slide the tall green column blocks on the left downward through the bottom exits.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Shift the blue/cyan column blocks on the right down once the green columns create room.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Clear the small cyan/blue blocks at the bottom through the down-arrow exits.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with any remaining column fragments.

failurePoints: Trying to move a tall column before the center lock blocks are cleared — the columns have no room.
Mismatching keys and locks, which wastes moves and leaves blocks gated.
